name: Roger

dialogue.text: Was my information helpful? Farewell, my dear Mapler!

idle_chatter.text: Open your Item Inventory to find your Equip, Use, Set Up, Etc, and Cash tabs.
Items you pick up will be automatically stored in the appropriate tab. Cool, huh?
Double-click on an item in your Item Inventory and you'll be able to use it
Want to discard an item? Then click on the item in your Item Inventory and drag it out of the window.
When your Item Inventory is full, you won't be able to pick up new items. You should get rid of unimportant items by either discarding them or selling them at a store.
Items in the Use tab can also be stored in the bottom right shortcut window where you can assign Hotkeys.
You'll die when your HP reaches 0, so it's for your own good to consume a potion or food before it's too late.
You want to go somewhere? Then come talk to me.
If you want to talk to someone, double-click on them.

lines.text: Eat the Roger's Apple I gave you by opening your inventory and clicking the Use tab. Double-click the Roger's Apple to recover some HP.
